stories.title: Two Cedar stints and an unsupported departure

memories.text: My first employment at Cedar Metrics, also called Cedar, ran from February 2016 through June 2018. I started as an analyst and became senior analyst in March 2017.
I worked at Flint Works as a planning specialist from July 2018 through January 2020. That was my only job between my two Cedar Metrics stints.
Old journal entry dated 3 February 2020: today I rejoined Cedar Metrics as a research lead.
I'm still continuously employed at Cedar Metrics as research lead since my return. My manager Robin approved next quarter's plan.
Ari Vale left Cedar Metrics in December 2025 and started at Gull Systems as director in January 2026.

stories.title: A June handover beside a continuing studio

memories.text: I was an operations analyst at Lumen Transit from April 2018 until June 2021.
My day job at Orchard Labs started in June 2021. I remain there as a service designer.
I founded my freelance business Moss Desk in 2019 and still run it as an illustrator alongside my day job. I renamed the same business Moss Studio in 2023; it was not a new job.
Through Moss Studio I illustrated for my client Fern Books from February 2024 through May 2024. I bought workspace access from Harbor Rooms for that project.
No recuerdo los días de junio de 2021: Lumen Transit pudo terminar antes o después de empezar Orchard Labs. Pudo haber solapamiento o días sin empleo principal; no sé más fechas.

I spent all of 2018 in full-time study without a job. The two short positions the following year were my first jobs.
I had no paid work from January 2020 through December 2021 while looking for work. I paid Ledger Grove for help with my old tax returns; they were my accountants.
I joined Vale Systems on 10 January 2022 as an operations planner and remain there. It's my only current job; my only other jobs were the two short positions recorded.

stories.title: A return to healthcare while the bureau stays open

memories.text: My first stint at Bracken Health ran from March 2015 through February 2018 as a service analyst.
I worked at Morrow Clinic as a care systems analyst from March 2018 through August 2020, my only day job between the two Bracken Health stints.
I returned to Bracken Health on 7 September 2020 as a service analyst. In April 2022 I was promoted to service design lead without leaving.
I've continuously run my side business Drift Desk since 2016 as a designer. It became Drift Bureau in 2021. Grebe Museum was my freelance client from May 2023 through July 2023.
My manager Casey and I privately negotiated a salary of 127000 at Bracken Health, still my day job as service design lead. Drift Bureau remains active as my side business.

stories.title: Dos vueltas a Canto y una actividad paralela

memories.text: Mi primer empleo en Canto Robotics fue de febrero de 2015 a diciembre de 2017 como especialista de pruebas. Canto es el nombre corto de esa empresa.
Mi único empleo principal entre las dos etapas de Canto Robotics fue Nube Devices, de enero de 2018 a diciembre de 2019, como analista de producto.
Regresé a Canto Robotics el 13 de enero de 2020 como responsable de pruebas y sigo allí sin interrupción. Mi compañero de trabajo Alex revisó conmigo el plan de otoño.
Sigo con mi negocio paralelo Isla Desk desde 2016 como especialista en documentación. Cliente: Marea Maps, de mayo de 2024 a julio de 2024. Compré billetes de Viento Air.
Ari Vale dejó Canto Robotics y cerró Isla Desk en diciembre de 2024. En enero de 2025 empezó su actual empleo en Zenith Fabrication como responsable de calidad.
